# Kala Art Wrap

> Kala Art Wrap (कला) is a small business in Jaipur, Rajasthan, India, that hand-makes bouquets from satin ribbon ("forever flowers") that never wilt. Every bouquet is made to order and fully customisable. Prices start at ₹199 and bouquets are usually ready in 3–5 days after the design is confirmed.

- Contact: WhatsApp / phone +91 90243 27497, Instagram @kala_art_wrap
- Location: Jaipur, Rajasthan, India
- Shapes: round, heart, square box, cone, single stem
- Extras: chocolates, handwritten note, name tag, pearls, fairy lights, baby's breath
- Occasions: birthday, anniversary, proposal, Valentine's Day, just because
